message: Hi, I'm a student with a app development certification background. My overall academic average is 79.7% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and security. Honestly I'm not fully sure what I want to become — something in tech. My family can afford at most about USD 31100 per year. I live in Mumbai. I'm open to going abroad. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program directly aligns with your interest in security (MSc Information Security) and is located in the USA, offering a strong job market. The tuition ($29150) is within your budget, and it provides valuable experience for securing a good job.

This MSc Cloud Computing program focuses on cybersecurity and networking, matching your interest in hacking/security. The tuition ($29650) is within budget, and the focus area makes it highly relevant for a tech career.

While focused on general software engineering, this program offers excellent job prospects (high median salary) and is located in the UK. It provides a solid tech foundation that can be specialized later to meet your career goals.

This MTech Computer Networks program offers strong technical skills in networking and software engineering. It has a high median starting salary ($81740) and is located in the USA, making it excellent for job placement.

This MSc IT Management program provides a good blend of IT management and software engineering. It has a reasonable tuition ($35050) and is located in the USA, offering strong career opportunities after graduation.
